source.title: CSIR-UGC NET Physical Sciences Syllabus
source.notes: Official CSIR-HRDG Physical Sciences syllabus; Part A Core and Part B Advanced retained as source sections.

nodes.title: Linear ordinary differential equations of first and second order
Special functions: Hermite, Bessel, Laguerre and Legendre functions
Fourier series, Fourier and Laplace transforms
Complex analysis: analytic functions, Taylor and Laurent series, poles, residues and evaluation of integrals
Elementary probability theory, random variables, binomial, Poisson and normal distributions
Dynamical systems, phase space dynamics and stability analysis
Two-body collisions and scattering in laboratory and centre-of-mass frames
Rigid body dynamics and moment of inertia tensor
Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formalism and equations of motion
Periodic motion: small oscillations and normal modes
Special theory of relativity: Lorentz transformations, relativistic kinematics and mass-energy equivalence
Electrostatics: Gauss law and applications, Laplace and Poisson equations, boundary value problems
Magnetostatics: Biot-Savart law and Ampere theorem
Maxwell equations in free space and linear isotropic media
Boundary conditions on fields at interfaces
Scalar and vector potentials, gauge invariance
Reflection and refraction, polarization, Fresnel law, interference, coherence and diffraction
Dynamics of charged particles in static and uniform electromagnetic fields
Eigenvalue problems: particle in a box and harmonic oscillator
Wave-function in coordinate and momentum representations
Motion in a central potential: orbital angular momentum, angular momentum algebra, spin and addition of angular momenta
Time-dependent perturbation theory, Fermi golden rule and selection rules
Identical particles, Pauli exclusion principle and spin-statistics connection
Laws of thermodynamics and their consequences
Thermodynamic potentials, Maxwell relations, chemical potential and phase equilibria
Micro-canonical, canonical and grand-canonical ensembles and partition functions
Free energy and its connection with thermodynamic quantities
Blackbody radiation and Planck distribution law
Semiconductor devices: diodes, junctions, transistors and field effect devices
Homo- and hetero-junction devices, device structure, characteristics and applications
Opto-electronic devices: solar cells, photo-detectors and LEDs
Digital techniques and applications: registers, counters, comparators and similar circuits
Data interpretation and analysis, precision and accuracy
Error analysis and propagation of errors
Partial differential equations: Laplace, wave and heat equations in two and three dimensions
Elements of computational techniques: roots, interpolation, extrapolation and integration
Solution of first order differential equations using Runge-Kutta method
Introductory group theory: SU(2) and O(3)
Dynamical systems, phase space dynamics and stability analysis
Radiation from moving charges and dipoles and retarded potentials
Elementary theory of scattering: phase shifts, partial waves and Born approximation
Relativistic quantum mechanics: Klein-Gordon and Dirac equations
Linear and nonlinear curve fitting and chi-square test
Transducers for temperature, pressure, magnetic fields, vibration, optical and particle measurements
Measurement and control, signal conditioning and recovery
Impedance matching, amplification, filtering and noise reduction
Fourier transforms, lock-in detector, box-car integrator and modulation techniques
High frequency devices including generators and detectors
Quantum states of an electron in an atom and electron spin
Spectrum of helium and alkali atoms
Relativistic corrections for hydrogen energy levels, hyperfine structure and isotopic shift
Width of spectrum lines and LS and JJ couplings
Nuclear magnetic resonance and chemical shift
Electronic, rotational, vibrational and Raman spectra of diatomic molecules and selection rules
Lasers: spontaneous and stimulated emission, Einstein A and B coefficients
Optical pumping, population inversion and rate equation
Modes of resonators and coherence length
Elastic properties, phonons and lattice specific heat
Free electron theory and electronic specific heat
Drude model of electrical and thermal conductivity
Electron motion in a periodic potential and band theory of solids
Superconductivity: type-I and type-II superconductors and Josephson junctions
Ordered phases of matter and liquid crystalline order
Basic nuclear properties: size, shape, charge distribution, spin and parity
Binding energy, semi-empirical mass formula and liquid drop model
Nature of the nuclear force and nucleon-nucleon potential
Charge independence and charge symmetry of nuclear forces
Evidence of shell structure and single-particle shell model
Alpha, beta and gamma decays and selection rules
Nuclear reactions, reaction mechanisms, compound nuclei and direct reactions
Classification of fundamental forces and elementary particles
Quantum numbers, Gell-Mann-Nishijima formula and quark model
Baryons, mesons, C, P and T invariance

source.title: GATE 2027 Physics (PH) Syllabus
source.notes: Official GATE 2027 Physics syllabus from IIT Madras.

nodes.title: Methods of measurement and error analysis
Grounding for electrical circuits and ground loops
Linear vector spaces: basis, orthogonality and completeness
Matrices: similarity transformations, diagonalization, eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Linear differential equations: first and second order applications and solutions
Complex analysis: Cauchy-Riemann conditions, Cauchy theorem, singularities and residue theorem
Tensors: tensor transformations, covariant and contravariant tensors
D'Alembert principle, Euler-Lagrange equation, Hamilton principle and calculus of variations
Central force motion and Kepler problem
Small oscillations: coupled oscillations and normal modes
Rigid body dynamics: inertia tensor, orthogonal transformations, Euler angles and torque-free symmetric top
Hamiltonian and Hamilton equations of motion
Special theory of relativity: Lorentz transformations, relativistic kinematics and mass-energy equivalence
Macrostates and microstates, phase space and ensembles
Partition function, free energy and calculation of thermodynamic quantities
Black body radiation and Planck distribution law
First and second order phase transitions, phase equilibria and critical phenomena
Electrostatic and magnetostatic problems including boundary value problems
Method of images and separation of variables
Dielectrics and conductors, magnetic materials and multipole expansion
Maxwell equations, scalar and vector potentials, Coulomb and Lorentz gauges
Electromagnetic waves in free space, non-conducting and conducting media
Reflection and transmission at normal and oblique incidences
Poynting vector, Poynting theorem, energy and momentum of electromagnetic waves
Wave equation: plane and spherical waves, superposition, standing waves and phase and group velocities
Interference: spatial and temporal coherence, dielectric films, Newton rings and multiple-beam interference
Michelson interferometer, Fabry-Perot interferometer and etalon
Diffraction: Fresnel and Fraunhofer diffraction, rectangular and circular aperture, Rayleigh criterion
Diffraction from double slit and many slits
Polarization: Jones vectors and matrices, birefringence and ray-transfer matrices
Lasers: Einstein coefficients, population inversion and two- and three-level systems
Basic ideas of quantum mechanics and uncertainty principle
Linear vectors and operators in Hilbert space
One-dimensional potentials: step, finite rectangular well, tunnelling and particle in a box
Particle in single and double delta function potentials
One-, two- and three-dimensional harmonic oscillator and degeneracy
Orbital and spin angular momenta and addition of angular momenta
Variational method and time-independent perturbation theory
Elementary scattering theory and Born approximation
Spectra of one- and many-electron atoms
Spin-orbit interaction, L-S and j-j coupling schemes
Electric dipole transitions and selection rules
Rotational and vibrational spectra of diatomic molecules
Electronic transitions in diatomic molecules and Franck-Condon principle
Raman effect and basics of Raman spectroscopy
NMR, ESR, X-ray and Mossbauer spectroscopies
Elements of crystallography and diffraction methods
Lattice vibrations and thermal properties of solids
Band theory of solids and nearly free electron model
Conductivity, electron and hole statistics, mobility and effective mass
Metal-semiconductor junctions, ohmic and rectifying contacts
Superconductivity: type-I and type-II superconductors, Meissner effect, London equation, BCS theory and flux quantization
Nuclear binding energy, electric and magnetic moments
Semi-empirical mass formula and nuclear models
Liquid drop model and nuclear shell model
Alpha decay, beta decay and electromagnetic transitions in nuclei
Rutherford scattering, nuclear reactions and conservation laws
Elementary particles: photons, baryons, mesons and leptons
Quark model, conservation laws, isospin symmetry, charge conjugation, parity and time-reversal invariance
p-n diodes, bipolar junction transistors and field effect transistors
Oscillators, operational amplifiers and active filters
Waveform generators: sine, square and triangular waves
Digital logic circuits, combinational and sequential circuits

source.title: JEST 2026 Physics Syllabus
source.notes: Official JEST document is labelled 2026. Syllabus is organized into six broad subject areas.

nodes.title: Linear differential equations and elements of Sturm-Liouville theory
Fourier series, Fourier transforms and Laplace transforms
Elements of probability theory and error analysis
Newton laws, conservation of energy and momentum and collisions
Generalized coordinates, principle of least action, Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formulations
Central force problem and Kepler problem
Electrostatics and magnetostatics, boundary value problems and multipole expansion
Fields in conducting, dielectric, diamagnetic and paramagnetic media
Faraday law and time varying fields, displacement current and Maxwell equations
Energy and momentum of electromagnetic fields
Propagation of plane electromagnetic waves, reflection and refraction
Electromagnetic waves in dispersive and conducting media
Orbital and spin angular momenta and addition of angular momenta
Matrix formulation of quantum theory, unitary transformations and Hermitian operators
Laws of thermodynamics, work and heat and thermodynamic potentials
Elements of kinetic theory and Maxwell relations
Classical ideal gas and harmonic oscillators
Classical and quantum statistics, Fermi and Bose gases
LCR circuits, rectifiers, amplifiers, active filters and oscillators
Basics of OPAMPs and their applications
